stories.headline: Study finds large language models apply harsher moral judgments to male actors in conflicts
stories.summary: Researchers introduced a benchmark called GAMA-Bench to evaluate how large language models respond to identical negative behaviors committed by men versus women. The study revealed that models consistently used more punitive and blame-centered framing for male actors while offering more empathetic responses to female actors.
stories.whyItMatters: Understanding bias in automated moral evaluation is critical as AI systems are increasingly deployed in decision-making roles.

stories.headline: OpenAI proposes perplexity as a shared metric for tracking AI progress
stories.summary: OpenAI has published internal perplexity measurements to encourage the industry to adopt a common standard for evaluating model capabilities. The company argues that tracking how well models compress data is key to understanding AI development and establishing shared safety standards.
stories.whyItMatters: A shared evaluation metric could improve transparency and comparison across different frontier AI models.

stories.headline: Wells Fargo updates customer agreements to limit liability for third-party AI agents
stories.summary: Wells Fargo is updating its customer agreements to state that the use of third-party AI agents is entirely at the customer's own risk. This move aligns with a broader trend of major companies blocking autonomous AI bots from making purchases on their platforms.
stories.whyItMatters: Financial institutions are establishing clear boundaries and risk ownership as consumers adopt autonomous AI tools for transactions.

stories.headline: Report finds most accounting firms lack infrastructure needed for generative AI adoption
stories.summary: A report by Wolters Kluwer Tax & Accounting indicates that while 88 percent of US accounting professionals use generative AI daily, only 13 percent of firms have the necessary digital infrastructure to support it effectively. The study highlights a gap between high enthusiasm and operational readiness.
stories.whyItMatters: Identifying infrastructure gaps helps organizations plan necessary investments to support sustainable AI integration.
